svg.text: ZIGURAT_VRTLOG_ENDER_X1 — the wrung ziggurat: the base square, the middle tier wrung an eighth of a turn, the top wrung back, helical columns, a wave that climbs, horns on the top corners, Hilbert roof 2-4-8-16
189.2 x 189.2 x 104.4 mm · Creality Ender-3 V4 · bead 0.42 (ASSUMED) · 3 tiers · tubes 172.6 / 112.19 / 51.78 mm · 522 layers · ~716 m thread
from above: foundation (grey), terraces — radial / diamonds / fine, roof levels
